newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone backs BT against Oftel - report.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone backs BT against Oftel - report.

text.p: British mobile telephone company Vodafone Group Plc is backing rival British Telecommunications Plc in its battle with the Oftel regulatory body, the Telegraph newspaper reported on Thursday.
The Telegraph said Vodafone was supporting BT in its legal battle against Oftel, which wants to take greater powers to investigate and take action over unfair trading practises.
The report cited a letter from Vodafone that said that while it accepted some of Oftel's arguments, it was also concerned about the implications of greater powers for its own side of the industry.
BT is seeking a judicial review of the plans. An application is due to begin in the High Court on December 17, the newspaper added.
